integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically by exhausting all 15 nonempty Kummer coefficient supports and translating full automorphisms and right nuclei; a standalone stdlib program independently confirms cyclic-projective orbit counts for q=5,9,13,17 and an auxiliary degree-6 case. Machine checks are finite, not a proof of all q.
limitations: Fixed Frobenius, degree 4, q congruent 1 modulo 4, noncentral parameters including possible zero divisors; enumeration of F-isomorphism classes rather than isotopy or semifields only. The structural isomorphism, automorphism and right-nucleus formulas are inherited from cited literature; originality concerns their exact simultaneous distribution. Independent audit not performed.
title: Five joint nucleus–automorphism strata for degree-four Petit algebras over finite fields
